model a mouthguard. eyes rolled up so that bottom 3rd is only visible
eyes staring off upper left
fix face clipping. add ref cam similar to other more recent renders
replay 3 full body with zoom pan across body. examine and fix shoulder clipping
right elbow extended after head impact with ground
scissor legs when extending elbow
raise/adjust camera slightly so that the face is visible in the final 3 replays
include heaving breathing. render fully. make her look more towards the upper corner rather than just upwards
reduce the intensity of the chin tuck (as if she was looking at her knees)
adjust so that she lays on her stomach and her face slides along the ground as she falls. keep legs tonic
ref cam from other side of body. add another underground view
fix right arm. I don't like how unnatural it looks for her to be holding up her body with her arm, let it flatten out a bit. she should be almost flat when as the tonic posture fades
right arm points higher at moment of ko, so that it's not keeping her up when she slumps forard
eyes more up and to the right. ref cam stops 1s after reaching final position

make the gaze aim upwards to the corner, rather than just up. make replay 3 a full body shot, not a zoom in. teeth clenched. legs begin scissoring and climaxes to a slight flutter upon impact with floor.
reduce core crunch by 10%. make replay 2 longer by 35%. make replay 3 longer. start panning over the body towards the head after 40% of the replay has played.
chin tilts upward as the ground and pound strikes land. eyes look up and to the side (30% of pupil visible
right arm full extension on ground during follow-up strikes
make replay 2 last until the tonic state relaxes. add another pov of a camera angle standing where the opponent stood
make the followup hit harder and more pronounced
make the followup hit harder and more pronounced. legs should jolt upon follow up inpact
eyes rolled up and to the side more, so that only 30% of the pupils are visible
more heavy breathing. asymmetric tonic upon followup strike (left arm extension, right arm contraction). eyes looking up and to the opposite side
one arm extended (elbow extension) the other arm contracted. classic fencing posture
after the follow up strike I want her to reset close to the same position, so her head snaps back, to sell the impression that she is stiff in the position she ended up in
followup strike happens 1s after she's hit the ground
can't see pupils. increase length of replay 2. add a zoom out to replay 5. fix hand clipping after followup
shoulders hunched forward, right elbow extended
right arm reaching up and to the left. render a glove to show each strike
up and to the left relative to marls pov, not the camera.
jolt limbs and head on each strike, not just the last one
replay 4 zooms into face (not back of head). make replay 3 a full body shot

I want a 3rd version where the head bounce doesn't increase the tonic intensity. mild tonic at impact, jolt on head impact with floor, and add a follow-up shot that increases the intensity of the tonic posture to a climax
fall forward
make the jolt more pronounced, almost changing the tonic posture into a similar but different one
good. add a 2nd follow-up shot that escalates the posture even more. make it so that the momentum of the 2nd follow-up hit rolls her on to her back. make it look organic
way too much momentum on the other strike. make it more subtle, but her final position should still be on her back
upon the follow up hit, increase the tonic posture more, make her arms lock out and scissor them, hunch her upper back off the mat
chin tilts up with each strike
the follow-up shot on the ground is missing. I want it to slightly roll her on her back. check why it was missed

make it multiple followup shots after she's hit the ground. the first one sends an impulse that snaps her head further towards the mat, escalating the posture and sending her arms straight. (already added, good) add a 2nd shot that will subtly turn her on her back, she should be on her back with at least 3s of runtime left on the sim
increase the length of renders 2 and 3 by 50%. add a zoom out to render 4
she still doesn't finish on her back. make sure her both sides of the back of her hips are touching the mat too.
extend this replay until the end of the sim. track marl from the same perspective. pan up and down
ref cam zoomed out and lasts for longer
final replay zooms out more by the end
on back not side. keep tonic posture
elbows locked straight upon head impact with ground. eyes looking up and to the side
upon taking the initial hit while standing, hinge at the hips more so that the head whips into the ground when falling backwards. keep the previous instructions otherwise

no. the hip hinge sends her back, I want the hip hinge to allow her to slump forward, but since her momentum is sending her back she falls back on to her ass which causes her upper half to whip into the canvas
I don't like the back arch. make it a back curl instead
increase length of replay 3 and ass pan up to face. ensure head doesn't hit the ground before her glues do.
her eyes are refracting weird here. please examine
the bend looks unnatural. please fix and make it more natural. she's hunched forward after the initial strike then hitting the ground whips her back like a whip and slams her head into the ground
make the right arm slowly rise as it hits max tonic posture
zoom out during this shot
generate an additional camera angle opposing her front on but from underground
underground angle zoomed out to full body
add crunching and relaxing to illustrate unconscious breathing

reduce the amount she spins around on the follow up shots. keep the head snapping to the side and back to neutral from the punch. arms jolt and unconsciously straighten out a little further with each impact
replay 3 circles around her
more quivering. ankles start to cross

shoulders shrugging, upper back hunching off canvas. replay 2 lasts 50% longer. at the end of replay 2, orbit around and pan from toe to head. ensure face is visible and not blocked by body. add camera angle underground showing the curled toes right before the final ref cam

I don't want sporratic hunching, I want an upper back hunch as a result of the impact that behaves like other tonic posturing (progress to determined intensity, then fade after a while). the underground angle should be a full body shot. zooming in and panning from head to toe back to head
reduce intensity of body bend by 40%

eyes looking up and to the left. 30% pupil visible. hands are halfway between fists and their current state. during the followup shots her legs start to scissor. ensure there is no clipping. I want to also test rendering the glove for the initial hit. nothing else from the opponent needs to be rendered.
make her eyes a more distinct, saturated color. add fist renderings for the followup shots too. make replay 2 start orbiting halfway through
fix the eye clipping here
final camera angle plays for longer
fades faster. fix neck. shoulder movement looks unnatural elbows reaching forward (relative to her). reduce leg elevation by 30%. analyze and fix inverse kinematics
